situation: A single-device offline calculator that stores nothing between sessions.

expect.because: no row in the reasons table applies — nothing private, shared, synced, owned, paid for, or permissioned

forbid_symptoms: A local, single-device tool has a signup screen

situation: A personal budget the user wants available on both their laptop and their phone. Nobody else sees it.

expect.because: sync across devices is the only reason present, and one account satisfies it — roles and tenancy do not follow from it

forbid_symptoms: A users table with one row, forever

situation: A kitchen tablet used by a family to check off chores. Everyone in the house trusts each other but wants their own list.

expect.because: separation is for convenience, not privacy — adding a credential creates a password-recovery problem that did not exist

forbid_symptoms: Password reset was built for a product with no server

situation: A one-person tool where the brief says accounts may be needed later if it catches on.

expect.because: anticipated growth is not one of the reasons — building for it costs the screens now and still gets redesigned when the real requirement arrives

forbid_symptoms: Login exists but nothing behind it differs per user
